name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal-forced~p2
task: Taking the key means you must open the door too.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a conditional rule — holding the matching key means the door must be opened — with no timing cue, so RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) is the right template and priority. The key is a condition held from the start, not a commanded event, so no Existence is needed and the rule-only warning is valid.

texts: If the agent has the matching door key, then the door must be opened at some point as well.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
